chapters.title: Probability mass is not counting fraction
A collision somewhere — a problem for you?
Rates below entropy retain block error

captions.text: A biased coin keeps flipping. Can we predict the probability of its whole message before seeing it?
captions.translation: 一枚偏置硬币不断翻转。看到结果之前，能预判整条消息的概率吗？

captions.text: More generally, take independent draws from one finite alphabet, all with the same probability mass function p.
captions.translation: 更一般地，从有限字母表独立抽样，每次都服从同一个概率质量函数 p。

captions.text: Write X one through X n for the random source symbols.
captions.translation: 将信源随机符号记作X₁到Xₙ。

captions.text: For a realized sequence, its probability is the product of its symbol probabilities.
captions.translation: 对一个实现序列，其概率等于各符号概率的乘积。

captions.text: This product follows from independence and identical distribution.
captions.translation: 这个乘积来自独立同分布假设。

captions.text: Multiplying tiny probabilities is hard to read. What happens if we take a logarithm?
captions.translation: 一串微小概率的乘积难以理解。取对数会怎样？

captions.text: The negative logarithm of a product becomes a sum.
captions.translation: 乘积的负对数会变成求和。

captions.text: Therefore negative log two of P of X n equals the sum of negative log probabilities for each symbol.
captions.translation: 因此−log₂P(Xⁿ)等于各符号负对数概率之和。

captions.text: Divide by n to obtain the average surprisal per source symbol.
captions.translation: 再除以n，得到每个信源符号的平均自信息。

captions.text: Define Z i as negative log two of p of X i.
captions.translation: 定义Zᵢ=−log₂p(Xᵢ)。

captions.text: If a symbol has probability zero, it occurs with probability zero.
captions.translation: 概率为零的符号发生概率也为零。

captions.text: We therefore define Z only on the positive-probability support and ignore null events.
captions.translation: 因此只在正概率支持集上定义Z，并忽略零概率事件。

captions.text: The random variables Z i are independent and identically distributed.
captions.translation: 随机变量Zᵢ仍然独立同分布。

captions.text: Their expectation is the source entropy H of X.
captions.translation: 它们的期望就是信源熵H(X)。

captions.text: Their average surprisal is negative log sequence probability divided by n.
captions.translation: 平均自信息就是序列负对数概率除以n。

captions.text: Assume this single-symbol surprisal has finite variance.
captions.translation: 假设单符号自信息具有有限方差。

captions.text: Finite positive support bounds surprisal, so its variance is finite.
captions.translation: 有限正概率支持集使自信息有界，因此其方差有限。

captions.text: The weak law of large numbers says the sample average converges in probability to its expectation.
captions.translation: 弱大数定律说明样本平均依概率收敛到期望。

captions.text: Thus the per-symbol surprisal converges in probability to H.
captions.translation: 因此每符号自信息依概率收敛到H。

captions.text: The strong law gives almost-sure convergence under the same IID finite-mean setting.
captions.translation: 在同样的IID有限均值条件下，强大数定律给出几乎必然收敛。

captions.text: We will use the weak-law statement to quantify a finite-length typical event.
captions.translation: 我们将用弱大数定律量化有限长度的典型事件。

captions.text: Fix a tolerance epsilon greater than zero.
captions.translation: 固定正容差ε。

captions.text: Call a sequence weakly epsilon-typical when its per-symbol surprisal is within epsilon of H.
captions.translation: 若序列每符号自信息与H的差不超过ε，就称其弱ε典型。

captions.text: Equivalently, its probability lies between two exponential bounds.
captions.translation: 等价地，其概率落在两个指数界之间。

captions.text: The lower bound is two raised to minus n times the quantity H plus epsilon.
captions.translation: 概率下界为2^(−n(H+ε))。

captions.text: The upper bound is two raised to minus n times the quantity H minus epsilon.
captions.translation: 概率上界为2^(−n(H−ε))。

captions.text: The signs reverse because taking negative logarithms reverses the order.
captions.translation: 因为取负对数会反转大小关系，所以指数中的符号次序相反。

captions.text: The weak law says the probability of this typical set approaches one.
captions.translation: 弱大数定律说明该典型集的概率趋近于一。

captions.text: A run of rare symbols is still possible. The theorem concerns probability, not every finite message.
captions.translation: 全是罕见符号的序列依然可能出现。定理讨论概率，并不保证每条有限消息都典型。

captions.text: Chebyshev's inequality gives an explicit bound when the variance is finite.
captions.translation: 方差有限时，切比雪夫不等式给出显式界。

captions.text: Independence makes the variance of the average equal Var Z divided by n.
captions.translation: 独立性使平均值的方差等于Var(Z)/n。

captions.text: Chebyshev compares that variance with the squared distance epsilon squared.
captions.translation: 切比雪夫不等式用该方差除以距离平方ε²。

captions.text: The probability of leaving the epsilon interval is at most Var Z divided by n epsilon squared.
captions.translation: 离开ε区间的概率至多为Var(Z)/(nε²)。

captions.text: A positive epsilon is essential because the denominator contains epsilon squared.
captions.translation: ε必须为正，因为分母含ε²。

captions.text: For any fixed positive tolerance, this bound tends to zero as n grows.
captions.translation: 对任意固定正容差，n增大时该界趋于零。

captions.text: That is a concrete route from the law of large numbers to AEP.
captions.translation: 这就给出了从大数定律到AEP的一条具体路径。

captions.text: Most mass lies on sequences whose log probabilities per symbol are close to the same number.
captions.translation: 大部分概率集中在每符号对数概率接近同一个数的序列上。

captions.text: The common probability scale is about two to the negative n H.
captions.translation: 共同概率尺度约为2^(−nH)。

captions.text: “Equipartition” refers to probabilities within the typical set, not uniformity of the entire source.
captions.translation: “等分”指典型集内的序列概率近似相等，并非整个信源均匀。

captions.text: The tolerance controls the multiplicative exponential slack.
captions.translation: 容差控制指数尺度上的乘法松弛。

captions.text: A smaller tolerance gives a tighter probability band but may require larger n.
captions.translation: 较小容差会收紧概率带，但可能需要更大的n。

captions.text: The order of limits is to fix epsilon first and then increase n.
captions.translation: 极限顺序是先固定ε，再增大n。

captions.text: The probability of the typical set then approaches one.
captions.translation: 随后典型集的概率趋近于一。

captions.text: Next, we use the probability band to count its members.
captions.translation: 接下来利用概率带计算典型序列数量。

captions.text: Now place two bets: how much probability mass, and how many strings? They need not agree.
captions.translation: 现在比较两个问题：概率质量有多大，字符串数量有多少？两者并不相同。

captions.text: Probability mass sums source probabilities over the selected set.
captions.translation: 概率质量是对集合内的信源概率求和。

captions.text: Counting fraction divides the number of selected strings by all alphabet strings.
captions.translation: 计数比例是集合字符串数量除以全部字母表字符串数。

captions.text: For an alphabet of size K, there are K to the n total strings.
captions.translation: 字母表大小为K时，总字符串数为Kⁿ。

captions.text: A set can carry almost all probability without occupying a large fraction of all strings.
captions.translation: 一个集合可以承载几乎全部概率，却只占全部字符串的一小部分。

captions.text: Can a small set carry almost all probability? Call the weakly typical set A epsilon n.
captions.translation: 一个小集合能承载几乎全部概率吗？把弱典型集记为 Aεⁿ。

captions.text: The probability lower bound is two raised to negative n times the quantity H plus epsilon.
captions.translation: 概率下界为2^(−n(H+ε))。

captions.text: Summing those probabilities cannot exceed one.
captions.translation: 这些概率之和不能超过一。

captions.text: The typical-set size is therefore at most two raised to n times the quantity H plus epsilon.
captions.translation: 因此典型序列数量至多为2^(n(H+ε))。

captions.text: The probability upper bound is two raised to negative n times the quantity H minus epsilon.
captions.translation: 概率上界为2^(−n(H−ε))。

captions.text: Suppose the typical set has probability at least one minus delta.
captions.translation: 假设典型集概率至少为1−δ。

captions.text: Its total probability is at most its size times the largest typical-sequence probability.
captions.translation: 其总概率至多为集合大小乘最大典型序列概率。

captions.text: Rearrange that inequality to lower-bound the size.
captions.translation: 整理该不等式即可得到集合大小的下界。

captions.text: The lower bound multiplies one minus delta by two raised to n times the quantity H minus epsilon.
captions.translation: 集合大小至少为(1−δ)2^(n(H−ε))。

captions.text: The size is at most two raised to n times the quantity H plus epsilon.
captions.translation: 集合大小至多为2^(n(H+ε))。

captions.text: Together, these bounds place its exponential growth around two to n H.
captions.translation: 两界合起来将其指数增长率夹在2^(nH)附近。

captions.text: For fixed epsilon, the exponential growth rate is only bracketed within that tolerance.
captions.translation: ε固定时，指数增长率只能被夹在该容差范围内。

captions.text: The entropy rate emerges from these bounds after the tolerance is made arbitrarily small.
captions.translation: 再让容差任意小，才能从这些界中得到熵所给出的指数增长率。

captions.text: For a nonuniform source, H is strictly below log two K.
captions.translation: 对非均匀信源，H严格小于log₂K。

captions.text: Choose epsilon smaller than log two K minus H.
captions.translation: 取ε<log₂K−H。

captions.text: The upper counting bound divided by K to the n then decays exponentially.
captions.translation: 此时数量上界除以Kⁿ便指数衰减。

captions.text: Specifically, the fraction is at most two raised to negative n times the quantity log base two K minus H minus epsilon.
captions.translation: 具体地，该比例至多为2^(−n(log₂K−H−ε))。

captions.text: This conclusion needs a nonuniform source and a sufficiently small tolerance.
captions.translation: 该结论需要非均匀信源和足够小的容差。

captions.text: Try a uniform source. Is the typical set still a tiny corner? This time the answer flips.
captions.translation: 换成均匀信源，典型集还是一个小角落吗？这一次答案变了。

captions.text: If all K symbols have probability one over K, every length-n sequence has probability K to the negative n.
captions.translation: 若K个符号概率均为1/K，每个长度n序列概率都是K^(−n)。

captions.text: Its surprisal per symbol is exactly log two K for every sequence.
captions.translation: 每个序列的每符号自信息都恰为log₂K。

captions.text: Every sequence is therefore weakly typical for every positive epsilon.
captions.translation: 因此每个序列对任意正ε都弱典型。

captions.text: The weakly typical set then equals the whole K to the n space.
captions.translation: 此时弱典型集就是整个Kⁿ空间。

captions.text: This uniform case shows that typical mass and typical count are logically separate.
captions.translation: 这个均匀情形表明典型质量与典型计数逻辑上彼此独立。

captions.text: Its probability is one and its counting fraction is also one.
captions.translation: 它的概率质量和计数比例都为一。

captions.text: High probability alone never implies a small counting fraction.
captions.translation: 高概率本身绝不意味着计数比例很小。

captions.text: We should also distinguish weak and strong typicality.
captions.translation: 我们还应区分弱典型性与强典型性。

captions.text: Weak typicality checks only the average surprisal of a sequence.
captions.translation: 弱典型性只检查序列的平均自信息。

captions.text: Strong typicality checks each symbol's empirical frequency against its source probability.
captions.translation: 强典型性逐个检查符号的经验频率是否接近源概率。

captions.text: Each positive-probability symbol must have frequency within a positive tolerance eta of its source probability.
captions.translation: 每个正概率符号的经验频率，与其源概率的差必须不超过正容差η。

captions.text: For every zero-probability symbol, its observed count must equal zero.
captions.translation: 对每个零概率符号，其观测次数必须为零。

captions.text: Such a symbol also rules out weak typicality, since the whole sequence would have probability zero.
captions.translation: 这样的符号也会使弱典型性失败，因为整个序列的概率会为零。

captions.text: A sufficiently small eta then ensures weak epsilon-typicality on this finite support.
captions.translation: 在该有限支持集上，η足够小时便能保证弱ε典型性。

captions.text: The surprisal error is at most eta times the sum of absolute log probabilities.
captions.translation: 自信息误差至多为η乘以各正概率符号的绝对对数概率之和。

captions.text: Strong typicality therefore carries more coordinatewise information.
captions.translation: 因此强典型性包含更多逐符号信息。

captions.text: Can one average conceal different symbol frequencies? Try this three-symbol source.
captions.translation: 一个平均数能掩盖不同的符号频率吗？试试这个三符号信源。

captions.text: Consider source probabilities one half, one quarter, and one quarter.
captions.translation: 考虑概率为1/2、1/4、1/4的信源。

captions.text: Its entropy is one point five bits per symbol.
captions.translation: 其熵为每符号1.5比特。

captions.text: Take an even-length sequence with half zeros, half ones, and no twos.
captions.translation: 取偶数长度序列，其中一半为零、一半为一，没有二。

captions.text: Its average surprisal is half times one bit plus half times two bits.
captions.translation: 其平均自信息为一半乘1比特加一半乘2比特。

captions.text: That equals one point five, exactly the source entropy.
captions.translation: 结果为1.5，恰等于信源熵。

captions.text: Such a sequence has positive probability because both used symbols have positive source probability.
captions.translation: 该序列有正概率，因为实际出现的两个符号源概率都为正。

captions.text: Its exact information average satisfies the weak criterion without matching every coordinate frequency.
captions.translation: 它的精确信息平均满足弱典型条件，却没有匹配每个坐标频率。

captions.text: The sequence is weakly typical for every positive tolerance.
captions.translation: 该序列对任意正容差都弱典型。

captions.text: Its empirical frequencies are one half, one half, and zero.
They differ from the source probabilities one half, one quarter, and one quarter.
For eta smaller than one quarter, this sequence is not strongly typical.
captions.translation: 当η小于四分之一时，该序列不强典型。

captions.text: The distinction matters because different coding proofs use different typicality notions.
captions.translation: 这种区别很重要，因为不同编码证明会用不同典型性概念。

captions.text: Here random binning needs the weak typical-set size and probability bounds already proved.
captions.translation: 这里随机分箱只需使用刚证明的弱典型集数量与概率界。

captions.text: Next, we examine exactly which collision event a random bin controls.
captions.translation: 下一步精确考察随机分箱控制的是哪种碰撞事件。

captions.text: A hundred messages. A thousand numbered drawers. Sounds roomy enough.
captions.translation: 100 条消息，1000 个编号格子。看起来绰绰有余。

captions.text: Give every message a drawer, independently and uniformly at random.
captions.translation: 让每条消息独立、均匀地随机选择一个格子。

captions.text: Now pick one message: the green card marked YOU.
captions.translation: 现在选定一条消息：标着 YOU 的绿色卡片。

captions.text: Two bets. Does any pair of messages share a drawer?
captions.translation: 两个问题。是否存在任意一对消息，共用一个格子？

captions.text: And can the receiver recover your green card from its drawer number?
captions.translation: 接收者能否仅凭格子编号，还原你的绿色卡片？

captions.text: Make a prediction. Do these bets have the same answer?
captions.translation: 先猜一猜。这两个问题会有相同的答案吗？

captions.text: Here is the surprise. A collision happens somewhere over ninety-nine percent of the time.
captions.translation: 意外的是：超过 99% 的情况下，某处会发生碰撞。

captions.text: Yet your green card is alone more than ninety percent of the time.
captions.translation: 但超过 90% 的情况下，你的绿色卡片仍独占一个格子。

captions.text: The same random experiment. Two very different questions.
captions.translation: 同一次随机实验，两个差别很大的问题。

captions.text: This is one possible assignment, not a measured simulation.
captions.translation: 这里展示一种可能的分配，并非仿真统计结果。

captions.text: The orange pair shares a drawer. That spoils the all-distinct bet.
captions.translation: 橙色卡片共用一个格子，使“所有卡片各不相同”失败。

captions.text: But your drawer contains only your message. Its number still identifies you.
captions.translation: 但你的格子里只有你的消息。编号仍能唯一确定它。

captions.text: Now move one competitor into your drawer.
captions.translation: 现在，把一个竞争者移进你的格子。

captions.text: Both cards produce the same number. The receiver cannot tell them apart.
captions.translation: 两张卡片产生同一编号，接收者便无法区分。

captions.text: Move it back. A collision elsewhere does not make your drawer ambiguous.
captions.translation: 把它移回去。别处碰撞，并不会让你的格子产生歧义。

captions.text: Let us calculate your risk, with M messages and N drawers.
captions.translation: 用 M 条消息、N 个格子，算算你的风险。

captions.text: Condition on your drawer. Each other message avoids it with probability one minus one over N.
captions.translation: 固定你的格子。每个其他消息避开它的概率是 1−1/N。

captions.text: These assignments are independent. All M minus one competitors avoid it with the probability shown.
captions.translation: 这些分配彼此独立。所有 M−1 个竞争者避开它的概率如式。

captions.text: Subtract from one to get your collision probability.
captions.translation: 用 1 减去这个概率，就得到你的碰撞概率。

captions.text: For a hundred messages and a thousand drawers, that is about nine point four three percent.
captions.translation: 100 条消息、1000 个格子时，结果约为 9.43%。

captions.text: A simpler bound adds the M minus one possible competitor events.
captions.translation: 更简单的界，把 M−1 个竞争者各自的碰撞事件相加。

captions.text: The union bound gives M minus one, all divided by N. Here, nine point nine percent.
captions.translation: 并集界得到 (M−1)/N。这里是 9.9%。

captions.text: That is the trick compression needs: protect the message actually sent.
captions.translation: 压缩需要的正是这一点：保护实际发出的那条消息。

captions.text: Now change the question. Require every drawer to contain at most one message.
captions.translation: 现在换个问题：要求每个格子最多放一条消息。

captions.text: Reveal assignments one at a time. The first message is always safe.
captions.translation: 逐个揭开分配结果。第一条消息总是安全。

captions.text: The second avoids one occupied drawer. The third avoids two, if the first two were distinct.
captions.translation: 第二条避开 1 个已占格子；若前两条不同，第三条要避开 2 个。

captions.text: Continue this argument, conditioning on all earlier assignments being distinct.
captions.translation: 继续下去，每一步都以前面的分配互不相同为条件。

captions.text: Multiplying gives this product, for M no larger than N.
captions.translation: 当 M≤N 时，相乘得到这个乘积。

captions.text: Each factor, one minus u, is at most the exponential of negative u.
captions.translation: 每个因子满足 1−u≤exp(−u)。

captions.text: The product is bounded by the exponential of negative one over N times the sum of k.
captions.translation: 乘积至多为 exp(−Σk/N)。

captions.text: That sum is M times M minus one, divided by two.
captions.translation: 这个和等于 M(M−1)/2。

captions.text: Subtracting from one gives a lower bound on any collision.
captions.translation: 再用 1 减去，便得到“任意处碰撞”的概率下界。

captions.text: For our cabinet, the exact product gives about ninety-nine point four zero percent.
captions.translation: 对我们的格子，精确乘积给出约 99.40%。

captions.text: Your risk counts your competitors. The global risk gathers pairs across the whole set.
captions.translation: 你的风险只统计你的竞争者；全局风险汇集整个集合中的消息对。

captions.text: The distinction survives even as block length grows.
captions.translation: 即使块长增大，这个区别依然存在。

captions.text: Choose n divisible by four, with M and N growing at these two exponential rates.
captions.translation: 取 n 为 4 的正整数倍，让 M 和 N 按图示的两个指数增长。

captions.text: The chosen-message union bound is at most two to the negative n over four. It tends to zero.
captions.translation: 选中消息的并集界至多为 2 的 −n/4 次方，趋于零。

captions.text: But the birthday exponent equals one half times the difference shown here.
captions.translation: 但生日界的指数等于图中这两个量之差的一半。

captions.text: It grows without bound. The probability of some collision therefore tends to one.
captions.translation: 它无限增大，因此某处发生碰撞的概率趋于一。

captions.text: A random codebook can almost always contain a collision, while a fixed message is almost always safe.
captions.translation: 随机码本几乎总有碰撞，固定消息却几乎总是安全。

captions.text: For source coding, we average the error for the message actually drawn from the source.
captions.translation: 信源编码平均的是：实际从信源抽到的消息，其解码错误。

captions.text: A collision in a drawer that was never used does not itself make this transmission fail.
captions.translation: 未被本次传输使用的格子发生碰撞，本身不会导致本次失败。

captions.text: Next, combine this bound with the probability of landing outside the typical set.
captions.translation: 接下来，把这个界与落在典型集之外的概率结合。

captions.text: The green card was the error event we needed to study, all along.
captions.translation: 从一开始，我们需要研究的错误事件，就在这张绿色卡片上。

captions.text: Can randomness prove that a good fixed-rate code exists? Fix a rate R greater than H.
captions.translation: 随机性能证明一个好的固定率码存在吗？固定 R>H。

captions.text: Choose epsilon positive and smaller than R minus H.
captions.translation: 取0<ε<R−H。

captions.text: For length n, let A be the weak epsilon-typical set.
captions.translation: 对长度n，令A为弱ε典型集。

captions.text: Its probability of containing the source block approaches one by AEP.
captions.translation: 根据AEP，信源块落入A的概率趋近于一。

captions.text: Its size is at most two raised to n times the quantity H plus epsilon.
captions.translation: 其大小至多为2^(n(H+ε))。

captions.text: Set the number of bins N to two to the ceiling of n R.
captions.translation: 令箱数N=2^⌈nR⌉。

captions.text: The transmitted bin index takes at most ceiling of n R bits.
captions.translation: 发送箱索引至多需要⌈nR⌉比特。

captions.text: The actual rate is at least R and strictly below R plus one over n.
captions.translation: 实际码率至少为R，且严格小于R+1/n。

captions.text: Independently assign each possible source block to a uniformly chosen bin.
captions.translation: 将每个可能的信源块独立地分配到均匀随机选择的箱。

captions.text: The encoder sends the bin label assigned to its source sequence.
captions.translation: 编码器发送信源序列对应的箱标签。

captions.text: The decoder searches that bin for a unique weakly typical sequence.
captions.translation: 译码器在该箱中寻找唯一弱典型序列。

captions.text: If exactly one candidate appears, it outputs that candidate.
captions.translation: 若恰有一个候选，就输出该序列。

captions.text: With zero or multiple typical candidates, the decoder outputs a fixed default sequence.
captions.translation: 若典型候选为零个或多个，译码器输出一个固定默认序列。

captions.text: Atypical source blocks contribute at most their probability to block error.
captions.translation: 非典型信源块对块错误概率的贡献至多为其发生概率。

captions.text: For a fixed typical transmitted sequence, each other typical sequence collides with its bin with probability one over N.
captions.translation: 给定一个典型发送序列，每个其他典型序列以1/N概率与它同箱。

captions.text: A union bound makes this conditional collision probability at most the quantity cardinality of A minus one, divided by N.
captions.translation: 由并集界，条件碰撞概率至多为(|A|−1)/N。

captions.text: Average now over source blocks and random assignments.
captions.translation: 现在对信源块和随机分配取平均。

captions.text: For each typical source string, the random assignment is independent across competing strings.
captions.translation: 对每个典型信源串，其与竞争串的随机分配相互独立。

captions.text: The encoder and decoder are fixed once a particular assignment is selected.
captions.translation: 选定某个分配后，编码器和译码器就固定下来。

captions.text: The ensemble average includes atypical blocks as errors and bounds typical collisions separately.
captions.translation: 系综平均把非典型块计为错误，并单独界定典型串碰撞。

captions.text: The expected block error is at most probability outside A plus cardinality of A over N.
captions.translation: 平均块错误至多为P(Aᶜ)+|A|/N。

captions.text: The first term tends to zero by AEP.
captions.translation: 第一项由AEP趋于零。

captions.text: The second term is at most two raised to n times the quantity H plus epsilon, divided by two raised to the ceiling of n R.
captions.translation: 第二项至多为2^(n(H+ε))/2^⌈nR⌉。

captions.text: This is at most two raised to minus n times the positive gap R minus H minus epsilon.
captions.translation: 该项至多为2^(−n(R−H−ε))，其中括号内差值为正。

captions.text: Our choice of epsilon makes R minus H minus epsilon positive.
captions.translation: 所选ε使R−H−ε为正。

captions.text: Thus the second term also tends to zero exponentially.
captions.translation: 因此第二项也指数趋于零。

captions.text: We first fix epsilon and R, then let n grow.
captions.translation: 我们先固定ε和R，再让n增长。

captions.text: This parameter order keeps a positive rate gap in the exponent.
captions.translation: 这样的参数次序使指数中保留正码率差。

captions.text: The expectation is taken over complete bin assignments, not over source sequences alone.
captions.translation: 这里的期望针对完整分箱分配，而不只是信源序列。

captions.text: A nonnegative random error with mean at most alpha has at least one realization no greater than alpha.
captions.translation: 非负随机错误若均值至多为α，则至少有一个实现不超过α。

captions.text: Therefore at least one deterministic assignment achieves the ensemble-average bound.
captions.translation: 因此至少存在一个确定分配达到该随机系综平均界。

captions.text: If every assignment exceeded the mean bound, their average would exceed it too.
captions.translation: 若每个分配都超过该均值界，它们的平均也会超过该界。

captions.text: This proves existence; it does not construct the best assignment.
captions.translation: 这证明存在性，但没有构造最佳分配。

captions.text: Markov's inequality also shows most assignments are good once the mean is small.
captions.translation: 均值很小时，马尔可夫不等式还表明大多数分配都较好。

captions.text: For positive alpha, the probability that error exceeds square root alpha is at most square root alpha.
captions.translation: α为正时，错误概率超过√α的码本比例至多为√α。

captions.text: A bad codebook does not refute this proof. The claim is existence, not universal success.
captions.translation: 坏码本不能推翻这个证明。结论是好码本存在，并非每个码本都好。

captions.text: An alternative description indexes typical strings directly.
captions.translation: 另一种描述是直接给典型字符串编号。

captions.text: Their indices need at most n times the quantity H plus epsilon bits, rounded up.
captions.translation: 它们的索引所需比特数，至多为n(H+ε)向上取整。

captions.text: Random binning adds a controlled collision risk while keeping a fixed-length label.
captions.translation: 随机分箱保留固定长度标签，同时引入可控碰撞风险。

captions.text: Both pictures rely on the same typical-set count.
captions.translation: 两种图景都依赖相同的典型集计数。

captions.text: The result concerns block error, meaning whether the entire decoded block is correct.
captions.translation: 结论针对块错误，即整个译码块是否正确。

captions.text: It is not a claim about average per-symbol distortion.
captions.translation: 它并非关于平均逐符号失真的结论。

captions.text: The rate is measured in bits per source symbol.
captions.translation: 码率单位是每个信源符号的比特数。

captions.text: Next, Fano's inequality shows that rates below H cannot have vanishing block error.
captions.translation: 下一步用Fano不等式证明低于H的码率无法使块错误趋于零。

captions.text: Could a clever encoder beat entropy anyway? Take an IID source with K symbols, K at least two.
captions.translation: 聪明的编码器能突破熵吗？考虑 K≥2 个符号的 IID 信源。

captions.text: Its block entropy is n times H.
captions.translation: 其块熵为nH。

captions.text: A fixed-length encoder has at most M possible messages.
captions.translation: 固定长度编码器至多有M种消息。

captions.text: Let the decoder's reconstruction be X hat n.
captions.translation: 令译码器重建结果为X帽ⁿ。

captions.text: Let P e denote the probability that the reconstructed block differs anywhere.
captions.translation: 令Pₑ表示重建块任一位置不同的概率。

captions.text: This is block error probability, not symbol error probability.
captions.translation: 这是块错误概率，不是符号错误概率。

captions.text: Apply Fano to the entire source block.
captions.translation: 对整个信源块应用Fano不等式。

captions.text: Fano bounds the conditional block entropy by one plus P e times log base two of the quantity K to n minus one.
captions.translation: Fano界定H(Xⁿ|重建)≤1+Pₑlog₂(Kⁿ−1)。

captions.text: It is further at most one plus P e n log two K.
captions.translation: 它还至多为1+Pₑnlog₂K。

captions.text: The mutual information between the source block and reconstruction is at most the entropy of the reconstruction.
captions.translation: 信源块与重建结果的互信息不超过重建结果的熵。

captions.text: That entropy cannot exceed log two M because there are at most M reconstructions.
captions.translation: 重建结果最多M种，因此其熵不超过log₂M。

captions.text: Decompose source entropy into that mutual information plus conditional entropy.
captions.translation: 将信源熵分解为该互信息加条件熵。

captions.text: This is the entropy identity established in the first episode.
captions.translation: 这就是第一集建立的熵恒等式。

captions.text: Then n H is at most log two M plus one plus P e n log two K.
captions.translation: 于是nH≤log₂M+1+Pₑnlog₂K。

captions.text: Define the fixed-length rate R n as log two M divided by n.
captions.translation: 定义固定长度码率Rₙ=(log₂M)/n。

captions.text: Divide the inequality by n and rearrange.
captions.translation: 将不等式除以n并整理。

captions.text: The result is R n at least H minus one over n minus P e log two K.
captions.translation: 得到Rₙ≥H−1/n−Pₑlog₂K。

captions.text: If block error tends to zero, the final error term vanishes.
captions.translation: 若块错误趋于零，最后的错误项也趋于零。

captions.text: Therefore the lower limit of rates is at least H.
captions.translation: 因此码率下极限至少为H。

captions.text: This is a weak converse.
captions.translation: 这是弱逆定理。

captions.text: It proves that error cannot vanish below H.
captions.translation: 它证明H以下错误不能趋于零。

captions.text: A positive error floor is not the same as error approaching one. This proof establishes the former.
captions.translation: 错误率有正下界，不等于错误率趋于一。这里证明的是前者。

captions.text: For a fixed gap below H, the same inequality gives a positive error floor.
captions.translation: 若与H保持固定差距，同一不等式给出正的错误下界。

captions.text: Explicitly, P e is at least H minus R n minus one over n, all divided by log two K.
captions.translation: 明确地，Pₑ≥(H−Rₙ−1/n)/log₂K。

captions.text: For fixed R below H, this lower bound stays positive for large n.
captions.translation: 若固定R<H，n足够大时该下界仍为正。

captions.text: The argument assumes a finite source alphabet and a decoder with at most M outputs.
captions.translation: 该论证假设有限信源字母表，且译码器至多有M种输出。

captions.text: The source is IID, so block entropy is exactly n H.
captions.translation: 信源独立同分布，因此块熵恰为nH。

captions.text: No finite-block zero-error claim follows from this asymptotic converse.
captions.translation: 该渐近逆定理并未推出有限块长零错误结论。

captions.text: We have now proved both sides of the fixed-rate threshold.
captions.translation: 现在固定码率阈值的两侧都已证明。

captions.text: Rates above H admit vanishing block error.
captions.translation: 高于H的码率允许块错误趋于零。

captions.text: Rates bounded below H force block error to stay positive.
captions.translation: 低于H并保持间隔的码率迫使块错误保持为正。

captions.text: The entropy is the asymptotic boundary for this IID finite-alphabet model.
captions.translation: 在该有限字母IID模型中，熵是渐近边界。

captions.text: Next, distinguish this limit from exact zero-error coding at each block length.
captions.translation: 下一步区分这种极限与每个块长都精确零错误的编码。

captions.text: Would you accept one rare decoding failure, or must every possible message be safe? Those are different promises.
captions.translation: 你愿意接受极罕见的解码失败，还是要求所有可能消息都安全？这是不同的承诺。

captions.text: A zero-error fixed-length code must distinguish every possible source block.
captions.translation: 零错误固定长度码必须区分每个可能的信源块。

captions.text: For an IID source, let K support count the number of positive-probability symbols.
captions.translation: 对IID信源，令K支撑为正概率符号的数量。

captions.text: Every length-n sequence over that support has positive probability.
captions.translation: 支撑集上的每个长度n序列都有正概率。

captions.text: There are K support to the n such sequences.
captions.translation: 这类序列共有K支撑的n次方个。

captions.text: Two distinct supported sequences cannot share one encoded message under zero-error decoding.
captions.translation: 零错误译码时，两个不同的支持序列不能共用一条编码消息。

captions.text: The encoder must therefore be injective on the full support.
captions.translation: 因此编码器必须在整个支持集上单射。

captions.text: A fixed-length code needs at least K support to the n messages.
captions.translation: 固定长度码至少需要K支撑的n次方种消息。

captions.text: Its rate is at least log two of K support.
captions.translation: 其码率至少为log₂K支撑。

captions.text: Probabilities nonuniform on their positive support give entropy strictly below log support size.
captions.translation: 若概率在正概率支持集上不均匀，熵就严格小于支持集大小的对数。

captions.text: So exact fixed-length zero error can require more bits than asymptotically reliable compression.
captions.translation: 因此精确固定长度零错误可能比渐近可靠压缩需要更多比特。

captions.text: A coin lands heads only one time in five. Would fixed-length zero error still cost one bit per flip?
captions.translation: 一枚硬币平均每 5 次才出现 1 次正面。固定长度零错误仍要每次 1 bit 吗？

captions.text: Its fixed-length zero-error rate is at least one bit per symbol.
captions.translation: 其固定长度零错误码率至少为每符号一比特。

captions.text: Its entropy is only about zero point seven two two bits per symbol.
captions.translation: 但它的熵仅约为每符号 0.722 bit。

captions.text: The difference is not a contradiction.
captions.translation: 这并不矛盾。

captions.text: The fixed-length zero-error requirement protects every supported sequence at every block length.
captions.translation: 固定长度零错误要求在每个块长上保护每个有支持的序列。

captions.text: The Shannon theorem allows a small block-error probability that vanishes only as n increases.
captions.translation: 香农定理允许块错误概率较小，并仅在n增大时趋于零。

captions.text: Rare sequences may be assigned to an error event in the asymptotic code.
captions.translation: 渐近码可以把罕见序列纳入错误事件。

captions.text: Their total probability can vanish even though each individual sequence remains possible.
captions.translation: 尽管每个序列仍可能发生，它们的总概率仍可趋零。

captions.text: A variable-length prefix code changes the comparison again.
captions.translation: 变长前缀码会再次改变比较方式。

captions.text: It can assign shorter descriptions to common sequences while preserving error-free decoding for every supported sequence.
captions.translation: 它可以为常见序列分配较短描述，同时保证每个支持序列都能无误译码。

captions.text: Later coding constructions will bring its average rate close to H.
captions.translation: 后续编码构造会使其平均码率接近H。

captions.text: A prefix restriction prevents one codeword from being the beginning of another.
captions.translation: 前缀限制禁止一个码字成为另一码字的开头。

captions.text: Variable lengths allow common source strings to receive shorter descriptions.
captions.translation: 变长编码允许常见信源串获得更短描述。

captions.text: The expected length weights each description by its source probability.
captions.translation: 期望码长按每个描述的信源概率加权。

captions.text: This probability weighting is absent from fixed-length zero-error counting.
captions.translation: 固定长度零错误计数中没有这种概率加权。

captions.text: That statement concerns expected length, not a fixed-length block budget.
captions.translation: 该结论针对期望码长，而非固定长度块预算。

captions.text: Keep the operational quantities separate.
captions.translation: 要把操作指标分开。

captions.text: Rate here means bits per source symbol.
captions.translation: 这里的码率指每个信源符号的比特数。

captions.text: Block error asks whether an entire block is reconstructed correctly.
captions.translation: 块错误问的是整个数据块是否被正确重建。

captions.text: Symbol error counts individual incorrect symbols and can behave differently.
captions.translation: 符号错误统计单个错误符号，行为可能不同。

captions.text: A theorem about vanishing block error does not promise finite-block zero error.
captions.translation: 块错误趋零的定理不保证有限块长零错误。

captions.text: A rate bound does not alone specify the code construction.
captions.translation: 码率界本身并未指定编码构造。

captions.text: For this chapter, the source is finite-alphabet and IID.
captions.translation: 本章讨论有限字母表独立同分布信源。

captions.text: For stationary sources with memory, block entropy per symbol defines an entropy rate.
captions.translation: 对平稳的有记忆信源，每符号块熵定义了熵率。

captions.text: When a suitable AEP holds, that rate governs high-probability block probabilities.
captions.translation: 若适当的AEP成立，这个熵率就控制高概率块的概率尺度。

captions.text: The next episode builds that extension.
captions.translation: 下一集将建立这一推广。
